prompt: A young adult East Asian woman standing in front of a pure black studio background, the frame is a close-up to half-body portrait, centered slightly to the right. The body is turned two-thirds toward the left, with the left shoulder closer to the lens, head gently turning back to look at the camera in a quiet, natural glance. Head tilted slightly to the right, chin slightly down, expression calm, restrained, slightly detached and melancholic, lips naturally parted, no obvious smile. She has a delicate oval face, almond deep brown eyes, natural thin brows, a slender nose bridge, and light nude-pink lips. Minimalist makeup, only fine eyeliner, natural lashes, light gray-brown eyeshadow, and low-saturation blush. Skin is fair and neutral-cool, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin tone variations, and natural highlights, no plastic skin smoothing. She has extremely long, thick dark black hair, flowing naturally with soft waves and a sense of weight. Most of the hair extends from the crown and shoulders to the bottom left, with rich layers; a few stray hairs across the forehead, eyes, and cheeks for a natural, imperfect look. She wears a black minimalist thin-strap camisole, soft matte knit or silk fabric, simple neckline showing neck and collarbones. Wearing an ultra-fine silver necklace with a small pendant, subtle and non-intrusive. Background is completely black or very deep dark gray, no visible objects. Low-key studio lighting: soft main light from the upper left front, gently illuminating the face, eyes, nose bridge, lips, left shoulder, and arm; most of the right side of the face and body in soft shadow. Only very weak rim separation between black hair and background, no strong rim light. Overall low saturation, low contrast, rich shadows, featuring cool gray-blacks, natural skin tones, and subtle silver layers. Photography style: 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/2, shallow depth of field, clear eyes and face, soft hair edges, real optical imaging, slight ISO 400 film grain, delicate shadow noise, Black Pro-Mist 1/8 slight softening, fine-art portrait, moody editorial portrait, photorealistic. Avoid: frontal ID photo pose, exaggerated expressions, heavy makeup, over-neat curls, plastic hair texture, strong rim lighting, gray background.

promptZh: 一位东亚年轻女性站在 纯黑影棚背景 前，构图为近景至半身人像，略微偏右居中。身体向左转动三分之二，左肩靠近镜头，头部轻微回转，以安静、自然的目光注视镜头。头部微向右倾，下巴微收，表情冷静、克制，带有一丝疏离感和忧郁，双唇自然微张，没有明显的笑容。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、深棕色杏眼、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁和浅裸粉色的双唇。妆容极简，仅有精致的眼线、自然的睫毛、浅灰棕色眼影和低饱和度腮红。肤色白皙且呈中性冷调，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、轻微的肤色差异和自然的肤质高光，没有塑料感的磨皮效果。她拥有一头极长且浓密的乌黑秀发，自然垂落，带有柔和的波浪感和垂坠感。大部分头发从头顶和肩部延伸至左下方，层次丰富；额头、眼睛和脸颊处散落几缕发丝，营造出自然、不完美的质感。她身穿 黑色极简细肩带吊带衫，材质为柔软的哑光针织或丝绸，领口简洁，露出颈部和锁骨。佩戴着 带有小吊坠的超细银项链，低调且不突兀。背景为全黑或极深暗灰色，无可见物体。低调影棚布光：左前方上方有柔和的主光，轻轻照亮面部、眼睛、鼻梁、嘴唇、左肩和手臂；右侧大部分面部和身体处于柔和的阴影中。黑色头发与背景之间仅有极弱的轮廓分离，没有强烈的轮廓光。整体低饱和度、低对比度，阴影丰富，呈现出冷灰黑色调、自然的肤色和细腻的银色层次。摄影风格：85mm 或 105mm 人像镜头，f/2 光圈，浅景深，眼睛和面部清晰，发丝边缘柔和，真实光学成像，轻微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，细腻的阴影噪点，Black Pro-Mist 1/8 柔光滤镜，艺术人像，情绪化编辑人像，照片级真实感。避免：正面证件照姿势、夸张的表情、浓妆、过于整齐的卷发、塑料感的头发质感、强烈的轮廓光、灰色背景。
